item.title: Bryan Dawson apologizes to the University of Montevallo after hosting postponed event
item.description: The original Feb 12. date was postponed by the university due to security concerns, following a threat on Dawson's life. Measures taken to ensure campus security included closing off roads, increased local and federal law enforcement presence and a sniper placed on a nearby academic building.

item.title: 26-year-old man killed in Leeds crash
item.description: LEEDS, Ala. (WIAT) -- The Leeds Police Department is investigating a crash that killed a 26-year-old man. Toye Jackson, of Odenville, was the lone rider of a motorcycle involved in a crash in the 7200 block of Elliot Lane in Leeds. He was transported to UAB Hospital, where he later died.

item.title: Former Democratic presidents remember the late Rev. Jesse Jackson during final public tribute
